recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit if a future work group decision creates or restores an Organization or Provider compartment; that would require a broader compartment spreadsheet review rather than an ExplanationOfBenefit-only fix.
issue_request: FHIR-11397 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Financial Management change request for ExplanationOfBenefit asking to add Patient, Provider, and Organization to compartments.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-11397, but February 2017 commits by the issue reporter added ExplanationOfBenefit to the compartments spreadsheet first with Patient/provider-style entries and then with patient/payee, encounter, payee, and enterer/provider/payee/care-team entries, matching the request timing before publication.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes explanationofbenefit and compartmentdefinition. The current compartment definitions are Patient, Encounter, RelatedPerson, Practitioner, Device, and Group; there is no current Organization or Provider compartment. Later FHIR-43309 R6 work renamed ExplanationOfBenefit.patient to subject and added Group support in compartments and search parameters.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source/compartments.xml ExplanationOfBenefit row maps Patient to subject/payee, Encounter to encounter, RelatedPerson to payee, Practitioner to enterer/provider/payee/care-team, Device to UDI fields, Group to subject, and date to created, so the current build already expresses the applicable compartment coverage.
